primary_failure_mode_caught: Consumes verified facts and assigns severity/priority.

assumptions.posture: Proposes factor scores and CVSS metrics from verified facts; Python computes severity and priority.

required_inputs: 12 review shard of independently verified records
outputs: factors, rationale and optional CWE, CVSS v4.0 metrics and remediation objective for each reviewed item
must_not: conflate severity with exploitability, exposure, confidence or business priority
